explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/743: Allen, Böttcher, Clemens, Hladký, Piguet and Taraz proved the conjecture 'when all the trees have maximum degree ≤ c·n/log n for some constant c > 0'. The Lean statement: ∃ c > 0 such that for all sufficiently large n, any trees T k (2 ≤ k ≤ n) with maxDegree ≤ c·n/log n pack into K_n. Faithful.
